wildfire.trigger_definition: 'NWS issues a Red Flag Warning when fire conditions are ongoing or expected to occur shortly.'
wildfire.action: Alert priority tracts; stage accessible transport; confirm shelter staffing and pet space.
wildfire.status: proposed – supports, does not replace, county plans

wildfire.trigger_definition: Official county order; not an NWS product.
wildfire.action: Open shelters/refuge outside the fire area; run accessible transport; issue multilingual messages through all channels.
wildfire.status: proposed – supports, does not replace, county plans

wildfire.trigger_definition: Hazard has passed; recovery sheltering begins.
wildfire.action: Recovery sheltering, feeding, mental health support, donations and volunteer management.
wildfire.status: proposed – supports, does not replace, county plans

tsunami.trigger_definition: No-notice hazard: plan as if there is no warning lead time (team_assumption). County sets the review date.
tsunami.action: PRE-POSITION: confirm shelters/refuge outside the tsunami evacuation zone (and extreme zone), transport plan for no-vehicle residents inside the zone, pre-approved multilingual evacuation messages.
tsunami.status: proposed – supports, does not replace, county plans

tsunami.trigger_definition: 'A tsunami warning is issued when a tsunami with the potential to generate widespread inundation is imminent' (or expected/occurring). Hawaii should refer only to PTWC messages for its region.
tsunami.action: Evacuate the zone; open refuge outside the zone; prioritize residents who cannot evacuate on their own.
tsunami.status: proposed – supports, does not replace, county plans

tsunami.trigger_definition: Hazard has passed; recovery sheltering begins.
tsunami.action: Shelter displaced households, feeding, power for medical devices, donations and volunteers.
tsunami.status: proposed – supports, does not replace, county plans

inland_flood.trigger_definition: No-notice hazard: plan as if there is no warning lead time (team_assumption). County sets the review date.
inland_flood.action: Mark shelters inside a FEMA Special Flood Hazard Area or zone D for site check; choose alternates.
inland_flood.status: proposed – supports, does not replace, county plans

inland_flood.trigger_definition: 'A Flash Flood Warning is issued when a flash flood is imminent or occurring.'
inland_flood.action: Open only shelters outside the SFHA; accessible transport where roads allow; multilingual messages.
inland_flood.status: proposed – supports, does not replace, county plans

inland_flood.trigger_definition: Hazard has passed; recovery sheltering begins.
inland_flood.action: Recovery sheltering and feeding for displaced households.
inland_flood.status: proposed – supports, does not replace, county plans

coastal_flood.trigger_definition: No-notice hazard: plan as if there is no warning lead time (team_assumption). County sets the review date.
coastal_flood.action: Mark coastal shelters in V/A zones for site check; choose inland alternates.
coastal_flood.status: proposed – supports, does not replace, county plans

coastal_flood.trigger_definition: 'Issued when tidal flooding or storm induced flooding is occurring, imminent or highly likely along coastal areas within approximately the next 12 hours.'
coastal_flood.action: Alert priority coastal tracts; confirm inland shelters and transport.
coastal_flood.status: proposed – supports, does not replace, county plans

coastal_flood.trigger_definition: Hazard has passed; recovery sheltering begins.
coastal_flood.action: Recovery sheltering and feeding for displaced households.
coastal_flood.status: proposed – supports, does not replace, county plans
